---
title: "Data and privacy"
---

The workshop's default is small, source-free synthetic data. It is shaped like survey/panel data for teaching joins, metadata, flags, weights, missingness, and release checks; it is not SOEP, does not reproduce SOEP weights, and must not be interpreted as substantive evidence.

“Public” is not the same as “approved for an external AI service.” Confirm institutional policy, contractual restrictions, provider retention/training settings, and account controls before sending any data. For this workshop, never send restricted rows, unpublished results, personal or participant data, or credentials.

See the [OpenCode Zen terms](https://opencode.ai/docs/zen/), [general OpenAI data controls](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/5722486-how-do-i-opt-out-of-my-content-being-used-to-improve-model-performance), and separate [Codex security/data guidance](https://developers.openai.com/codex/security/). For Google/Antigravity, consult its current [permissions](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/permissions/) and [CLI usage](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/using/) pages; telemetry controls are not a confidentiality guarantee. These policies change; recheck before publication.
